$comment: Shared contract for animated vector icons. Both the native Zig plugin and the maplibre-gl-js layer are tested against this file. `"values": "catalog"` means the enum values are "none" followed by the registered catalog's animation names, in catalog order. `"expressions"` is "camera" (constants and zoom expressions) or "data-driven" (also feature, composite and feature-state expressions); absent means "camera". `"transition"` says whether a `<name>-transition` key is accepted; absent means true for numeric types and false for enums.

icon-animation.doc: The catalog animation to draw, chosen per feature when data-driven; none draws nothing.

icon-size.doc: Scale factor on the animation's display size (the longer side of its anchor box, in logical pixels).

icon-rotate.doc: Rotation in degrees clockwise; transitions take the shortest arc.

icon-opacity.doc: Opacity of the whole icon, applied after its shapes are composited, so overlaps inside the icon never show through.

icon-color.doc: Recolors the animation's primary color slot. The alpha is the strength: 0 keeps the authored colors, 1 replaces them.

icon-offset.doc: Offset [right, down] from the anchor, in logical pixels scaled by icon-size.

icon-anchor.doc: Which point of the animation's anchor box sits on the feature.

icon-rotation-alignment.doc: map keeps the icon's up pointing north as the map rotates; viewport keeps it upright on screen; auto is viewport, as for point symbols.

icon-pitch-alignment.doc: map lays the icon on the ground plane; viewport keeps it facing the camera; auto follows icon-rotation-alignment.

icon-animation-speed.doc: Playback rate multiplier, clamped to −4..4: 0 holds the frame at icon-animation-offset and negative plays backwards; a constant change sweeps the playhead during the transition unless icon-animation-speed-transition has duration 0.

icon-animation-offset.doc: Seconds added to the playhead, to desynchronize icons (for example from ["id"]) or to restart one by subtracting a start time read from the plugin clock (clockSeconds() or mln_animated_icon_clock_seconds), never a wall-clock time.

icon-animation-mode.doc: loop repeats, alternate plays forward then backward, and once plays a single time and holds the last frame (the first frame before it starts).
